domainTreatments.name: Implement Continuous Living Cover Systems
domainTreatments.description: Maintain living plant cover on fields year-round through cover crop sequences, relay cropping, or perennial understory systems. Continuous root activity maintains soil structure, feeds soil biology, and prevents the aggregate breakdown that occurs under bare fallow conditions.

domainTreatments.name: Coach on Diverse Crop Rotation Design
domainTreatments.description: Train agronomists to design crop rotations that diversify root architectures, carbon input quality, and biological interactions across rotation phases. Diverse rotations build more resilient soil food webs than simplified corn-soybean systems under climate stress.

domainTreatments.name: Establish Erosion Control Buffer Infrastructure
domainTreatments.description: Install contour buffer strips, grassed waterways, and terrace systems designed for projected peak rainfall intensities. Structural erosion control preserves topsoil depth and prevents the loss of organic-matter-rich surface horizons that underpin soil resilience.

domainTreatments.name: Create Soil Health Mentorship Programs
domainTreatments.description: Pair experienced soil health practitioners with operations beginning their resilience-building journey for multi-year mentorship relationships. Sustained guidance through the transition period reduces abandonment of practices before soil health benefits materialize.

domainTreatments.name: Use Soil Water Balance Simulation Tools
domainTreatments.description: Deploy soil water balance models that simulate infiltration, drainage, and plant-available water dynamics under different management scenarios and climate projections. Scenario modeling reveals which practices deliver the greatest soil moisture resilience under drought conditions.

domainTreatments.name: Implement Equivalent Soil Mass Calculations
domainTreatments.description: Apply equivalent soil mass corrections when comparing carbon stocks across time periods or management systems to account for changes in bulk density caused by management practices. Failure to correct for mass equivalence systematically biases carbon stock change estimates in no-till and other soil-building systems.

domainTreatments.name: Coach on Dry Combustion Analysis Interpretation
domainTreatments.description: Train laboratory staff and data analysts on interpreting dry combustion total carbon results including corrections for inorganic carbon in calcareous soils, instrument calibration verification, and quality control flag interpretation. Proper analysis interpretation prevents systematic errors in carbon stock reporting.

domainTreatments.name: Establish Reference Site Monitoring Networks
domainTreatments.description: Maintain undisturbed reference plots alongside managed fields to separate management-driven carbon changes from background climate and environmental trends. Reference comparisons are required by most carbon credit methodologies to demonstrate additionality of management practices.

domainTreatments.name: Promote Measurement Transparency Standards
domainTreatments.description: Adopt open data reporting standards for carbon measurement results including full disclosure of methods, quality metrics, uncertainty estimates, and raw data access. Transparency builds trust with verification bodies, carbon buyers, and the broader scientific community.

domainTreatments.name: Use Statistical Power Analysis Calculators
domainTreatments.description: Deploy statistical power analysis tools to determine the minimum sample size needed to detect expected carbon stock changes at specified confidence levels. Power analysis optimizes the trade-off between sampling cost and detection capability for each measurement campaign.
